summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its participation in the Ophthalmology Futures European Forum on September 10 and the 5th Annual ESCRS iNovation Day on September 11 in London. The company highlighted progress advancing its lead asset urcosimod through the global Phase 3 NEPTUNE trial for neuropathic corneal pain, following positive FDA Type D meeting feedback. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed; the filing is a routine conference-participation update incorporated by reference into its F-3 shelf registration statement.
